title: Make task normalizer malformed-JSON skips visible
description: The bulk task-record normalizer intentionally skips malformed JSON so one corrupt historical record does not abort the entire normalization sweep, but its warning was itself wrapped in an empty catch and could be silently swallowed. Replace the nested warning catch with Write-Warning so skipped task records are always observable while preserving the non-fatal skip behavior. This keeps task-ledger maintenance honest without making historical cleanup fail closed.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: Scripts/Normalize-TaskRecords.ps1 now emits a direct Write-Warning when ConvertFrom-Json fails and still increments Skipped/continues. No repository task record is silently hidden by the warning path. Script execution was not available in this harness.
